The theorem provides the exact attainable directional anisotropy envelope, all uniqueness conditions and a sharp forbidden finite-rate interval with reentrant feasibility. These are quantitative design boundaries for imperfect orientation actuators and cannot be inferred solely by inserting an arbitrary single reset angle into the known deterministic reset formulas.
